subject: Onboarding benchmark sprint ops plan — FastFin trial acceptance
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fastfin.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding benchmark sprint ops plan — FastFin trial acceptance

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the acceptance benchmarks this month. Per our kickoff last week, I've attached a concise load test plan (fastfin_onboard_load_plan_v1.pdf) and a short runbook (redwood_runbook_ddt.md) that covers the two sprint windows we've proposed. High-level acceptance targets you told us were important:

- 95th percentile generation latency <= 350 ms for single-request 512-token prompts
- Sustained throughput >= 60 req/s for the baseline instruction mix
- No request error rate > 0.5% during nominal load

Planned sprint windows (UTC-7):
1) Dry run: Jun 08, 13:00–14:30 — low concurrency smoke tests, KV/prefix cache check
2) Load window: Jun 10, 14:00–16:00 — ramp to target concurrency, 60–75 req/s sustained, two 15-min peaks at 120 req/s

Goals for this thread: confirm timestamps we should use on your end, identify the FastFin contact who will run the CloudOps side, and confirm whether you need us to spin up a dedicated pool for the load window or whether your reserved capacity is sufficient.

If the windows above work, we'll have Dev and Connor onsite (virtual) to watch the metrics and iterate the tuning parameters.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a brief checklist once you confirm.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: fastfin_onboard_load_plan_v1.pdf, redwood_runbook_ddt.md
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fastfin.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: FastFin CloudOps <cloudops@fastfin.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding benchmark sprint ops plan — FastFin trial acceptance

Neha — thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. The windows look good for the squad; Jun 10 load window works best for us. A couple quick clarifications from CloudOps: 

- We will run the load from our AWS account (ap-south-1), IP ranges listed in the plan are ok.
- We have a reserved pool that should handle up to ~80 req/s for short bursts; we may need Redwood to enable extra burst capacity for the 120 req/s peak. Can you confirm the cost / permission model for a temporary burst?
- We'll need a DNS-friendly endpoint and the exact model variant + version to pin during the run (to ensure caching behaviour matches production).

I'll loop in our lead CloudOps engineer (cc'd) to coordinate the run. Please share the exact CLI commands or k6 script you recommend for the ramp profile.

Elena Rossi
Head of Product Ops | FastFin Payments
elena.rossi@fastfin.com
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fastfin.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding benchmark sprint ops plan — FastFin trial acceptance

Elena / team — attaching the exact run commands and a baseline k6 script snippet below. If you prefer a hosted run, we can also trigger from Redwood's QA pool and stream results to the Drive link.

--- k6 snippet (ramp profile) ---
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';

export let options = {
  stages: [
    { duration: '5m', target: 10 },
    { duration: '15m', target: 60 },
    { duration: '30m', target: 75 },
    { duration: '10m', target: 120 },
    { duration: '10m', target: 0 }
  ],
  thresholds: { 'http_req_duration': ['p(95)<350', 'rate<0.5'] }
};

export default function () {
  let payload = JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'Summarize the transaction for fraud analysis', max_tokens: 512 });
  let params = { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer <REDACTED>' } };
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', payload, params);
  sleep(0.1);
}

Operational notes:
- Model variant: rwinf-7b-v2-quant (locked for the run)
- If you need to breach 80 req/s for the 15-min peak, file a burst request by 24 hours prior; Dev/Connor can initiate a temporary pool change.
- We'll stream token-level latency and per-route error rate to the shared Drive folder in near-real time.

Attachments: redwood_runbook_ddt.md (already shared), fastfin_onboard_load_plan_v1.pdf

—Dev
Dev Patel
SRE, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fastfin.com>, FastFin CloudOps <cloudops@fastfin.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding benchmark sprint ops plan — FastFin trial acceptance

Team — quick summary after today's load window (results attached: fastfin_jun10_results.csv). TL;DR: acceptance criteria met with a single recommended tuning.

Key outcomes:
- 95th percentile latency: 338 ms (target <= 350 ms)
- Sustained throughput: 63 req/s average over the 90-minute window (target >= 60 req/s)
- Peak 15-min burst to 120 req/s: sustained for 12 minutes; observed transient error rate spike to 0.9% during the peak, quickly recovered after auto-shed policy activated

Recommended follow-ups (owner / due):
1) Increase burst headroom by enabling temporary dedicated pool for peak events — Connor to action, ETA Jun 14.
2) Add a small client-side retry (linear backoff, max 2 retries) in the FastFin request library for short-lived gateway errors — FastFin devs, ETA Jun 17.
3) Run a production validation (non-disruptive) next month with the same script and signed acceptance form — Neha/Marissa to coordinate with procurement.

I've uploaded the full metrics export and a short runbook note on the error spike to the Drive link (see related_links). Once you've had a chance to review, can you confirm acceptance so we can close the onboarding project and move to regular billing? If you want a 30-minute readout with the SREs, we can set that up early next week.

Thanks everyone for the quick coordination — great to see the platform meeting the targets with only minor client-side changes needed.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments: fastfin_jun10_results.csv
